notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.0
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "GIRLS MADE PUDDING". We have just released an update.

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new Tapes featuring character voices for Sumibi and Nikomi, performed by kahoca, Muto, Ichinose Himari, and m. These can be found as items after clearing the game.
[*] Added 13 new Meals.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the explanation in Topics to make it easier to locate the Laboratory and Hut. Also made them appear in some maps where they previously didn't.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could become unplayable on the "STORY" difficulty.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could become unplayable after acquiring the Topic "Sumibi #2".
[*] Fixed a bug in the Amida-kuji mini-game where the window wouldn't close after the time limit expired.
[*] Corrected typos and omissions.
[/list]
We hope you continue to enjoy  "GIRLS MADE PUDDING".

notes.title: Regarding a Currently Confirmed Issue
notes.content:
Thank you for playing GIRLS MADE PUDDING.

We are currently aware of the following issue:

When the mode is set to "STORY", the game may become impossible to progress after obtaining the topic "Question".
If you encounter this issue, you can proceed by using the following method:

Temporarily change the mode to "NORMAL" or "CASUAL". (The mode can be changed from the Options menu on the home screen or title screen.)
We plan to fix this issue in an update for the Steam version scheduled for next week.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience.

notes.title: "GIRLS MADE PUDDING" Exhibiting at Tokyo Game Dungeon 7!
notes.content:
Attention to all those eagerly awaiting "GIRLS MADE PUDDING"! We have an announcement about an event where you can play the game.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tokyogamedungeon7]Tokyo Game Dungeon 7 Steam Event Page (東京ゲームダンジョン7 Steamイベントページ)[/url]
[url=https://tokyogamedungeon.com/]Tokyo Game Dungeon Official Site (東京ゲームダンジョン 公式サイト)[/url]

We will be exhibiting at Tokyo Game Dungeon 7, held in Hamamatsucho, Tokyo on Sunday, February 16th.
In addition to exhibiting a playable demo of "GIRLS MADE PUDDING", we will also be distributing acrylic coasters to those who have wishlisted the game. Please come to Hamamatsucho this weekend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335398/e98b29c22be0c0f544a6851416c6763abc5ac892.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335398/7cf76df043e341b041c459650e008093c59f58b1.png[/img]

[h3]Event Overview (開催概要)[/h3]
Tokyo Game Dungeon 7 (東京ゲームダンジョン7)
[list]
[*]  Exhibition and distribution of digital games created by individuals and small teams in Japan (国内の個人や小規模チームが制作したデジタルゲームの展示、頒布)
[*]  Visitors can try out and purchase games, and interact with developers (来場者は作品の試遊や購入、開発者との交流ができます)
[/list]
[h3]Date and Time (開催日時)[/h3]
February 16, 2025 (Sunday) 12:00〜17:00 (2025年2月16日(日) 12:00〜17:00)

[h3]Venue (会場施設)[/h3]
Tokyo Metropolitan Industrial Trade Center Hamamatsucho Building 5th Floor Exhibition Hall (東京都立産業貿易センター 浜松町館 5階展示室)

[h3]Fee (料金)[/h3]
750 yen (1 day, tax included) (750円（1日、税込）)

Free entry after 16:00 (※16:00以降の入場は無料)
Free for elementary school students and younger all day, but must be accompanied by a parent or guardian (※小学生以下は終日無料、ただし保護者同伴が必須)
